name: Never Have I Ever
blurb: Statements, not questions. Everyone who has done it puts a finger down, and then tells the story.

howToPlay: Read the card aloud. Everyone who HAS done it puts a finger down (or drinks).
Anyone who put a finger down owes the table the story.
Swipe up when the room is ready for the next level.

tiers.name: Cheeky
tiers.description: Things you did and got away with.

tiers.name: Confessional
tiers.description: Now it costs something to put a finger down.

tiers.name: Spicy
tiers.description: Adults only, and the story is the point.

cards.text: Never have I ever been relieved when a friend's good news fell through.

Never have I ever begged someone to take me back.

Never have I ever wanted someone in this room.
